headline: US Justice Department is looking into Nvidia's planned Hugging Face acquisition, Reuters sources say
body: The US Justice Department is looking into Nvidia's planned acquisition of Hugging Face, according to two sources cited by Reuters. The deal is worth $12.93 billion, and Nvidia expects it to close in the first half of 2027. The company says Hugging Face will keep supporting partnerships with a range of chip, cloud, and AI providers.
note: Hugging Face is where many open models are distributed, so the review is relevant to any bank or insurer that downloads open-weight models.

evidence.text: The US Justice Department is looking into Nvidia's planned acquisition of open-source platform Hugging Face.
According to two sources cited by Reuters , department officials are asking whether the purchase could give Nvidia control over a key hub for distributing AI and hurt its competitors.
The deal is worth $12.93 billion, and Nvidia expects it to close in the first half of 2027.
The company says Hugging Face will keep supporting partnerships with a range of chip, cloud, and AI providers.
